fields.statement: Change set 01M76B50 (ship-change sends non-test CI failures to wait-ci-rerun): when the head's failed jobs have been rerun once and fail again, how should rhiza ship check decide that a failure with no failing test is fixable (route it to ci-fix) and not infra (wait-ci-rerun)? / Change set 01M76B50: how should build and review runs keep checked-in generated files (Rhiza's docs/reference from rhiza docs) current, so stale generated reference never reaches CI? / Change set 01M76B50, part 3 (wait-ci-rerun waiting forever): PR #441 (ship-change-infra-wait-reruns, landed) already makes wait-ci-rerun rerun the failed jobs itself with backoff over its 6h window and then end the run naming the failure. What more should this change set do for part 3?
